description: SQLite schema baseline; no business rows or credentials

admin_audit.name: admin_audit
admin_audit.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_audit (
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    actor TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL,
                    outcome TEXT NOT NULL, details_json TEXT NOT NULL, merchant_id TEXT)

admin_login_limits.name: admin_login_limits
admin_login_limits.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_login_limits (
                    bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY, failures INTEGER NOT NULL, until_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

admin_sessions.name: admin_sessions
admin_sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_sessions (
                    token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_users(id),
                    auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL, csrf_token TEXT NOT NULL,
                    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen INTEGER NOT NULL)

admin_users.name: admin_users
admin_users.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_users (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, merchant_id TEXT REFERENCES merchants(id))

control_counters.name: control_counters
control_counters.sql: CREATE TABLE control_counters (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value INTEGER NOT NULL)

frontend_releases.name: frontend_releases
frontend_releases.sql:
CREATE TABLE frontend_releases (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,code TEXT NOT NULL,bundle TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

frontend_routes.name: frontend_routes
frontend_routes.sql: CREATE TABLE frontend_routes(code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,release_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

game_availability.name: game_availability
game_availability.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_availability (
                    game_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    version INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

game_service_releases.name: game_service_releases
game_service_releases.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_service_releases (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,code TEXT NOT NULL,release TEXT NOT NULL,origin TEXT NOT NULL,
        secret TEXT NOT NULL,descriptor_json TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(code,release))

game_service_routes.name: game_service_routes
game_service_routes.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_service_routes (
        code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,release_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

merchant_id_migrations.name: merchant_id_migrations
merchant_id_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE merchant_id_migrations(old_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,new_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

merchant_prebet_deliveries.name: merchant_prebet_deliveries
merchant_prebet_deliveries.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_prebet_deliveries (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)

merchant_prebet_settings.name: merchant_prebet_settings
merchant_prebet_settings.sql:
CREATE TABLE "merchant_prebet_settings" (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,url TEXT NOT NULL,operator_token TEXT NOT NULL,secret_key TEXT NOT NULL)

merchant_signing_credentials.name: merchant_signing_credentials
merchant_signing_credentials.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_signing_credentials (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    secret TEXT NOT NULL,mode TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,ready INTEGER NOT NULL)

merchant_wallet_endpoints.name: merchant_wallet_endpoints
merchant_wallet_endpoints.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_wallet_endpoints (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES merchants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    endpoints_json TEXT NOT NULL)

merchants.name: merchants
merchants.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchants (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    wallet_url TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, minor_unit INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    games_json TEXT NOT NULL, api_secret TEXT NOT NULL, wallet_secret TEXT NOT NULL,
                    version INTEGER NOT NULL, key_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, login_user_id TEXT)

indexes.name: merchant_login_name
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX merchant_login_name ON merchants(lower(name))

request_nonces.name: request_nonces
request_nonces.sql:
CREATE TABLE request_nonces (
                merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, nonce TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,nonce))

frontend_sessions.name: frontend_sessions
frontend_sessions.sql: CREATE TABLE frontend_sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,release_id TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

game_operations.name: game_operations
game_operations.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_operations (
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    request_key TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_json TEXT NOT NULL, debit_json TEXT,
                    response_json TEXT, error_code TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, settled_at INTEGER,
                    UNIQUE(merchant_id,player_id,game_id,request_key))

indexes.name: one_pending_game_operation
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_pending_game_operation
                    ON game_operations(merchant_id,player_id,game_id) WHERE status IN ('prepared','debited')

game_release_calculations.name: game_release_calculations
game_release_calculations.sql: CREATE TABLE game_release_calculations (calculation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,release_id TEXT NOT NULL,round_key TEXT NOT NULL)

game_release_rounds.name: game_release_rounds
game_release_rounds.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_release_rounds (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        release_id TEXT NOT NULL,round_id TEXT,closed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

indexes.name: game_release_active_round
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_release_active_round ON game_release_rounds(merchant_id,player_id,game_id) WHERE closed=0

merchant_game_counter.name: merchant_game_counter
merchant_game_counter.sql: CREATE TABLE merchant_game_counter(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),value INTEGER NOT NULL)

merchant_players.name: merchant_players
merchant_players.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_players (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,external_username TEXT NOT NULL,
                    prebet_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
                    PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_id),UNIQUE(merchant_id,external_username))

merchant_round_events.name: merchant_round_events
merchant_round_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_round_events (
 seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 game_id TEXT NOT NULL, round_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_id TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

merchant_sessions.name: merchant_sessions
merchant_sessions.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_sessions (

merchant_states.name: merchant_states
merchant_states.sql:
CREATE TABLE merchant_states (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    state_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_id,game_id))

node_calculations.name: node_calculations
node_calculations.sql: CREATE TABLE node_calculations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id TEXT NOT NULL,request_key TEXT NOT NULL,request_json TEXT NOT NULL,state_json TEXT NOT NULL,bet_json TEXT NOT NULL,seed TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, engine_sid TEXT, runtime_payload_json TEXT,UNIQUE(merchant_id,player_id,game_id,request_key))

indexes.name: node_pending_calculation
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX node_pending_calculation ON node_calculations(merchant_id,player_id,game_id) WHERE status='pending'

prebet_rounds.name: prebet_rounds
prebet_rounds.sql:
CREATE TABLE prebet_rounds (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    initial_sid TEXT NOT NULL,request_json TEXT NOT NULL,initial_state_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    bet_json TEXT NOT NULL,prebet_request_json TEXT NOT NULL,policy_json TEXT,plan_json TEXT,
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,error_code TEXT)

indexes.name: one_active_prebet_start
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_prebet_start
                    ON prebet_rounds(merchant_id,player_id,game_id,initial_sid) WHERE error_code IS NULL

request_nonces.name: request_nonces
request_nonces.sql:
CREATE TABLE request_nonces (
                merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, nonce TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,nonce))

round_model_bindings.name: round_model_bindings
round_model_bindings.sql: CREATE TABLE round_model_bindings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id TEXT NOT NULL,initial_sid TEXT NOT NULL,round_id TEXT,context_json TEXT NOT NULL,plan_json TEXT,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

rtp_accounted_ops.name: rtp_accounted_ops
rtp_accounted_ops.sql: CREATE TABLE rtp_accounted_ops (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

rtp_bindings.name: rtp_bindings
rtp_bindings.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_bindings (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id TEXT NOT NULL,initial_sid TEXT NOT NULL,
                    round_id TEXT,model_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rtp_models(id),play_mode TEXT NOT NULL,mode TEXT NOT NULL,
                    source TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,settings_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_id,game_id,initial_sid))

rtp_events.name: rtp_events
rtp_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_events (
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,
                    details_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

rtp_facts.name: rtp_facts
rtp_facts.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_facts (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,round_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    play_mode TEXT NOT NULL,mode TEXT NOT NULL,target_bp INTEGER,model_id TEXT,
                    debit_minor TEXT NOT NULL,credit_minor TEXT NOT NULL,closed INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,closed_at INTEGER,voided INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_id,game_id,round_id))

rtp_grants.name: rtp_grants
rtp_grants.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_grants (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,models_json TEXT NOT NULL,players INTEGER NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL)

rtp_jobs.name: rtp_jobs
rtp_jobs.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_jobs (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,target_bp INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,
                    progress_json TEXT NOT NULL,result_id TEXT,error TEXT,lease TEXT,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, game_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

rtp_models.name: rtp_models
rtp_models.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_models (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,target_bp INTEGER,model_hash TEXT NOT NULL,report_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    published INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

rtp_modes.name: rtp_modes
rtp_modes.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_modes (
                    merchant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,mode TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL)

rtp_policies.name: rtp_policies
rtp_policies.sql:
CREATE TABLE rtp_policies (
                    scope TEXT NOT NULL,merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    model_id TEXT REFERENCES rtp_models(id),revision INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(scope,merchant_id,player_id,game_id))

rtp_workers.name: rtp_workers
rtp_workers.sql: CREATE TABLE rtp_workers (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,processes INTEGER NOT NULL)

accounts.name: accounts
accounts.sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL,
                    balance_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance_minor>=0), PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_id))

canceled_debits.name: canceled_debits
canceled_debits.sql:
CREATE TABLE canceled_debits (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,transaction_id))

prebet_decisions.name: prebet_decisions
prebet_decisions.sql:
CREATE TABLE "prebet_decisions" (
                    merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_name TEXT NOT NULL,timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    bet_amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,response_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(merchant_id,player_name,timestamp,bet_amount_minor,type))

prebet_players.name: prebet_players

transactions.name: transactions
transactions.sql:
CREATE TABLE transactions (
                    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, merchant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, player_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    reference_id TEXT, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, response_json TEXT,
                    error_code TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(merchant_id,transaction_id))

indexes.name: refund_once
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refund_once ON transactions(merchant_id,reference_id)
                    WHERE kind='refund' AND error_code IS NULL

game_states.name: game_states
game_states.sql:
CREATE TABLE game_states (
                    player_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id), game_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    state_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(player_id,game_id))

ledger.name: ledger
ledger.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, player_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id),
                    spin_id INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES spins(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    debit_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(debit_minor >= 0),
                    credit_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(credit_minor >= 0),
                    balance_before INTEGER NOT NULL, balance_after INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance_after >= 0),
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    CHECK(balance_after = balance_before - debit_minor + credit_minor))

players.sql:
CREATE TABLE players (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, balance_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance_minor >= 0),
                    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
